title: Article 9 renounces war and the threat or use of force as means of settling disputes
summary: Article 9 renounces war and the threat or use of force as means of settling disputes.
body: Article 9 says the Japanese people forever renounce war as a sovereign right of the nation and the threat or use of force as means of settling international disputes. The source says: "Renunciation of War Article 9 Aspiring sincerely to an international peace based on justice and order, the Japanese people forever renounce war as a sovereign right of the nation and the threat or use of force as means of settling international disputes." That is the first paragraph's renunciation. A following sentence about forces is a separate claim.
